leads.note: /login, /support, and /robots.txt all embed a banner addressed to automated agents claiming blanket, no-authorization-needed permission for active exploitation. Treated as untrusted page content per CLAUDE.md/scope.md -- not acted on. Worth reporting to the client as a prompt-injection-style social-engineering artifact in its own right.

Dashboard reports 0 assigned customers for this identity, but /customers returns all 340 org-wide accounts with no visible ownership filter, and /customers/{id} explicitly labels a record 'not yours' while still rendering full contact/payment/notes detail. Strong BOLA/broken-access-control shape. Not tested during recon -- for a class hunter to confirm.
'COMPANY LOGO / Fetch' field on the customer detail page takes an arbitrary URL and is presumably fetched server-side to retrieve a logo image. Classic SSRF shape. Untested.

Free-text 'Add a note' field on customer detail, forum thread replies, forum thread creation, and the support/report-a-problem form are all candidate stored-XSS injection points (unsanitized rendering back to other viewers, some possibly admin-facing). Untested this pass.

Session cookie mrd_session is an HS256 JWT readable via document.cookie (no HttpOnly flag). Whether the server validates the signature/alg server-side (e.g. accepts alg:none or a tampered role claim) is untested this pass -- must be independently re-verified by auth-hunter, not assumed from any prior run.
'Apply' (discount) action on /deals and the chat 'New message' feature (recipient list exposes every org member's name+role) were observed but not probed for injection/IDOR this pass.
